why: Python writes __pycache__ beside a script the first time it imports one, so the guard's own directory grows files the guard itself created. changed_files() counts anything git does not ignore, so in a consumer whose .gitignore has no Python section — a Rust, C# or TypeScript repo, which is most of them — the first stop after adoption was a refusal over a file no human touched. This is the receipt's self-reference bug in a second costume.
